what: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol through aelix's own openai-codex provider and the owner's aelix login (owner decision 2026-10-07, updated, on Issue #40: replaces the API key path)

auth.what: the owner's ChatGPT login stored by aelix's /login (OpenAI Codex) in aelix's own credential store, ~/.aelix/agent/auth.json by default; aelix reads and refreshes it in place through tools/model_eval_aelix.py, the harness never opens it

serving.snapshot: none: the catalog row names no dated snapshot (2026-10-07)
serving.tokenizer: not published: counts come from the backend's usage only
serving.listed: aelix 0.1.0b2 --list-models with the owner's login: openai-codex gpt-5.6-sol, context 1.1M, max-out 128K, thinking yes, images yes
serving.catalog: aelix 0.1.0b2 models_generated.json openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol: api openai-codex-responses, baseUrl https://chatgpt.com/backend-api, reasoning true, input text and image, contextWindow 1,050,000, maxTokens 128,000, thinkingLevelMap minimal -> low, xhigh -> xhigh
serving.reasoning: thinking medium: aelix sends reasoning {effort: medium, summary: auto} (clamp_thinking_level keeps medium; the levels offered are off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh)
serving.request: aelix's codex body: instructions = the system prompt, store false, stream true, text.verbosity low, include reasoning.encrypted_content, tool_choice auto, parallel_tool_calls true, tools with strict null, prompt_cache_key = the session id (cache retention short); aelix sends no sampling values
serving.billing: the ChatGPT subscription of the login; the catalog's price row (input 5, output 30, cached input 0.5 per million tokens) is the API's and is not what this login is charged
serving.usage: openai-codex-responses reads the backend's usage with the shared Responses engine: aelix records input = input_tokens - cached_tokens, cache_read = cached_tokens, reasoning = output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens (0 when absent; a subset of output), cache_write written 0 without reading
